speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Renal Cell Carcinomas. The patient is a 42-year-old male with gross hematuria, right flank pain, and a history of recurrent UTIs. The IVP finding of multiple cysts in the collecting ducts is a classic radiographic sign of multifocal renal cell carcinoma, which can mimic cysts.
